comment: BarDelay - one tempo-synced mono delay with six engines on the Type knob: DIGI (clean), TAPE (wow, flutter, gliding time), DUB (band-limited, saturated, self-oscillating loop), REVRS (reversed chunks that start on the beat), TAPS (three taps inside Time) and LOFI (each repeat crumbles). Time is free 12 ms..1 s or a note value 1/32..2bar at the Tempo knob; Fdbk, Tone, Char (meaning per engine), Duck (repeats dip while you play), Mix (DJ crossfade), Tempo (knob 8, twin copies, FOLLW), Tail (repeats ring out or stop when switched off). 7.9 s 16-bit ring.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 493 Breather, 494 SyncEQ, 495 BarDelay. Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.
audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.

params.name: Type
params.comment: Engine: 0 DIGI clean, 1 TAPE wow/flutter/dark/gliding time, 2 DUB band-limited saturated loop that self-oscillates, 3 REVRS reversed chunks of Time starting on the beat, 4 TAPS three taps inside Time, 5 LOFI repeats lose bits and rate on every pass. Default DIGI.

params.name: Time
params.comment: 0..100 free: ms = 12 + 0.0988 x screen^2 (12 ms..1.00 s), as DualShft. 101..113 = note values at the Tempo knob: 1/32, 1/16T, 1/16, 1/8T, 1/16., 1/8, 1/4T, 1/8., 1/4, 1/4., 1/2, 1bar, 2bar. Too long for the 7.9 s ring = halved until it fits (REVRS needs twice the time). Default 108 = 1/8. (dotted eighth).

params.name: Fdbk
params.comment: Feedback. Loop gain at 100: DIGI 0.95, TAPE 1.08, DUB 1.25, REVRS 0.9, TAPS 0.85, LOFI 1.0 (TAPE, DUB and LOFI can run on forever; the saturator holds them). Default 45.

params.name: Tone
params.comment: Dark to bright: low-pass in the loop, 0.8..15.7 kHz (TAPE 0.6..7.8 kHz); on DUB it moves the band (HP 100..400 Hz, LP 0.5..4 kHz). Default 60.

params.name: Char
params.comment: Per engine: DIGI slight modulation, TAPE wow/flutter depth, DUB drive, REVRS chunk edge fade (choppy..smooth), TAPS pattern (0..24 1/4 1/2 1, 25..49 3/8 3/4 1, 50..74 1/3 2/3 1, 75..100 1/2 3/4 1 of Time), LOFI crush (12 bits full rate .. 4 bits 1/8 rate). Default 30.

params.name: Duck
params.comment: How far the repeats dip while you play (instant attack, about 0.23 s release); they swell back in the gaps. 0 = off. Default 0.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade, DJ style: dry full up to 50, wet full from 50, both full at 50. Default 50.

params.name: Tempo
params.comment: BPM 40..240 for the synced Time values; 0..39 = FOLLW (follows the bar tag from an earlier slot); 241..441 = twin copy (BPM = screen - 201): flipping between a BPM and its twin restarts the REVRS chunk on the bar. Knob 8 as on every synced effect. Default 120.

params.name: Tail
params.comment: When switched off: ON = the repeats ring out and decay like the factory delays (nothing new goes in), OFF = they stop at once. The input passes untouched either way. Default ON.
